          type: boolean
          example: true

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as "LastName, FirstName".
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the title followed by
                a space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'

              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-

                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' and assigned on create: REGION is the

                registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized

                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-

            MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to derive
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-

            compatibility with the flat address form. On create it is
            normalized and, when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied,
            the returned value is composed from the structured fields instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When a
            non-blank value is supplied the structured form is preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number

            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

          title: Postcode
          description: >-

            must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table

          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'

          title: Registration date
          description: >-

          properties:

              format: int32

              example: 1

              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the title followed by
                a space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' and assigned on create: REGION is the
                region derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or 'UNKNOWN'), FY
                is the two-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                telephone and last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
                over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an
                existing owner's memberId, '-<n>' is appended with the smallest n
                of 2 or more that makes it unique.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW273F9A0C177'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on
                or after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following
                calendar year. Absent when no registrationDate is recorded.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household,
                assigned deterministically on create as the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode.
                Owners with the same last name and postcode automatically share
                the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case hex
                SHA-256 of 'normalizedTelephone|<lower-case email or empty>|soundex(lastName)'.

                identityKey equals an existing (non-deleted) owner's.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. The score starts at 0 and gains 2
                when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 when the
                household has 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds one
                elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer

              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level

                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:

              maximum: 4

              example: 2

              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                with a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible

            capacityWarning:

            riskFlag:

              description: >-
                A derived overall risk indicator, computed on read. True when any
                of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate

                disposable-adjacent (the domain's registrable label matches a
                known disposable provider, e.g. under a different TLD), or its

            locality:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically MR, MRS,
            MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to derive
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On create it is
            normalized and, when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied,
            the returned value is composed from the structured fields instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When a
            non-blank value is supplied the structured form is preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when not
            supplied it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Given and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already shares its household (same last name and postcode) that
            would otherwise be rejected as a household duplicate; such a declared
            member is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; used only
            during create and not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as "LastName, FirstName".
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the title followed by
                a space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner-identity contract this response follows.
                Always 2: the identifiers are grouped under the 'identity' object
                and are derived with the version-2 algorithm (a fixed 'V2' version
                tag mixed into the region code used inside the identifiers).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on
                or after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following
                calendar year. Absent when no registrationDate is recorded.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household,
                assigned deterministically on create as the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode.
                Owners with the same last name and postcode automatically share
                the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically MR, MRS,
            MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to derive
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On create it is
            normalized and, when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied,
            the returned value is composed from the structured fields instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When a
            non-blank value is supplied the structured form is preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when not
            supplied it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Given and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already shares its household (same last name and postcode) that
            would otherwise be rejected as a household duplicate; such a declared
            member is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; used only
            during create and not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as "LastName, FirstName".
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the title followed by
                a space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner-identity contract this response follows.
                Always 2: the identifiers are grouped under the 'identity' object
                and are derived with the version-2 algorithm (a fixed 'V2' version
                tag mixed into the region code used inside the identifiers).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on
                or after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following
                calendar year. Absent when no registrationDate is recorded.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. The score starts at 0 and gains 2
                when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 when the
                household has 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds one
                elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5
                points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                with a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of; absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A derived overall risk indicator, computed on read. True when any
                of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), its email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (the domain's registrable label matches a
                known disposable provider, e.g. under a different TLD), or its
                city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived on read and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from 'birthDate' measured
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                is recorded.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true while retaining the
                record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

**Identity derivation (V2 — every identifier changes, no V1 value recurs)**
- Added a fixed `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"` on `Owner`.
- `Owner.getIdentityKey()` now hashes `"V2|" + telephone + "|" + email + "|" + soundex(lastName)` — duplicate-detection semantics preserved, value changed.
- `householdIdFor()` (controller) now hashes `"V2|" + normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode` — household grouping preserved (still a pure function of last name + postcode), value changed.
- `memberIdFor()` now uses a new `identityRegion()` = `"V2" + postcodeRegion` (e.g. `V2NSW`, `V2UNKNOWN`) as the `<REGION>` segment, so the member id becomes e.g. `V2NSW2716E6609E7`.

**User-facing region stays plain (no `V2` tag)**
- `locality()` no longer parses the region out of the memberId (which now carries `V2`); it resolves the plain region directly from postcode → city table (`NSW`/`VIC`/`QLD`/`UNKNOWN`).
- `fiscalYear()` now derives `FY<YY>` directly from `registrationDate` instead of parsing the memberId.
- `timezone` and `ownerSegment` derive from the plain `locality`, so their region never carries the tag (confirmed: `ownerSegment=STANDARD_METRO` for an NSW owner).

- OpenAPI: removed top-level `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey`; added an `OwnerIdentity` schema and grouped the three under a nested `identity` object; added a top-level integer `apiVersion` (2).
